Fifty years after Mao's death, China still grapples with his legacy
subhed: 'Mao's Fraught Legacy' (1/7). Mao Zedong, who died on September 9, 1976, founded the People's Republic of China and still casts a shadow over the country's political life. The Chinese Communist Party, whose power base Mao established, remains divided between loyalty to his myth and condemnation of his 'mistakes,' which led to the deaths of tens of millions of people.

title: Mario Draghi, the 'sphinx' still shaping the EU's agenda
subhed: At 79, the former president of the European Central Bank, who no longer holds any official office, remains at the heart of European Union politics. Elusive and deliberately secretive, he skillfully leverages his ability to speak to political leaders, business executives, and financial markets alike.
